issue.title: Notebook, project-note, and ref created: stamps label New York wall time as +0000 on UTC-clock hosts (format_created_timestamp uses chrono::Local, not the configured timezone)
issue.description:
Found while researching notebook section capture (research:202611/notebook_section_bullets__cld.md, Appendix A).

## Root cause

`capture_project_note::format_created_timestamp` (and `format_captured_timestamp`, via
`format_timestamp_with_format`) resolves the naive `now` with `chrono::Local`, the
**process** timezone. Since bob-cli-2q, `now` is wall-clock time in Bob's
**configured** timezone (`env::configured_timezone()`, America/New_York). On a host
whose system timezone is Etc/UTC (apollo), New York wall time gets the `+0000`
offset. `records/plan.rs::format_created_timestamp` already takes `Option<Tz>` and
gets this right; the shared helper does not.

## Affected writers (callers of the Local-based helper)

- `src/native/notebooks/create.rs:287` (`bob notebooks create`, capture `@parent^id@ %n`)
- project-note capture (`@route^id@`), which uses the same helper
- `src/native/highlights_ref/note.rs:65` (ref notes)
- `src/native/records/cli.rs:837` (check whether it passes a timezone)

## Fix sketch

Pass `env::configured_timezone()` into the shared helper (the records version already
has the right shape, including the DST-gap fallback), and add a test with
`TZ=Etc/UTC` plus a configured America/New_York zone that expects `-0500`/`-0400`.
Also check whether an RFC 3339 `BOB_NOW` with an explicit offset should be honored:
`BOB_NOW=2026-11-11T10:00:00-05:00` was ignored (it fell back to the clock), while
`BOB_NOW="2026-11-11 10:00"` worked.

task_type_fields.impact:
Every notebook, project note, and ref created from apollo (or any UTC-clock host) has
a `created:` instant five hours early (four during EDT). Anything that reads it as an
instant (Dataview, sorting, `bob notebooks` recency if it ever uses frontmatter)
shifts. Notes created after 19:00 local time get an instant on the previous UTC day
boundary relative to their wall date. Mac captures are unaffected when the Mac's
local zone is New York.
task_type_fields.repro:
On apollo (system TZ Etc/UTC, `date -u` = 13:01), with a scratch vault holding an area `dev`:

    bob notebooks create dev nvim -s "Neovim notes" -b <vault> -d

prints `+created: 2026-11-11T08:01:12+0000`. 08:01 is New York wall time, so the
correct stamp is `2026-11-11T08:01:12-0500`. Capture `Neovim notes @dev^nvim@ %n`
(dry run, JSON `note_files[].markdown`) writes the same `+0000` form.
docs/notebooks.md shows the intended form, `created: 2026-11-09T09:14:00-05:00`.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching notebook section capture: on apollo, bob notebooks create wrote 08:01:12+0000 when UTC was 13:01, so every created: instant written from a UTC host is off by the Eastern offset.

payload.description: Same apollo Etc/UTC root family: 2q moved now to the configured timezone, but format_created_timestamp still labels it with chrono::Local's offset

evidence.note: Independent repro (research.45.cdx lead, bob 0.5.0 built 2026-11-11 11:09 UTC, scratch vault): via the capture path rather than bob notebooks create. With host TZ unset (/etc/timezone Etc/UTC) at 13:25 UTC, 'bob capture -- "Third notes @dev^third@ %n"' wrote 'created: 2026-11-11T08:25:22+0000'. With TZ=America/New_York the same capture writes '-0500' correctly, consistent with the chrono::Local root cause. Recorded in research:202611/notebook_section_groups/notebook_section_groups__final.md §3 bug 8.

payload.entry: Fixed by bob-cli-kj.4 commit 04cba0fa: shared format_created/captured_timestamp helpers take Option<Tz>; notebook, project-note, ref, records, and capture callers pass the configured zone; records delegates to the shared helper; RFC 3339 BOB_NOW with an explicit offset is honored (bob_now decision = honor). Verified by bob-cli-kj.land at 3ba40fc5: just check green incl. configured_zone_controls_created_offset_on_utc_clock_hosts, render_stamps_created_in_the_configured_zone, created_stamp_uses_the_configured_zone_on_utc_clock_hosts, bob_now_with_an_explicit_offset_is_honored; live dry run 'TZ=Etc/UTC BOB_NOW="2026-11-11 08:01:12" bob notebooks create dev nvim -d' stamps created: 2026-11-11T08:01:12-0500 (installed 0.5.0 stamps +0000), and BOB_NOW=2026-11-11T13:01:12Z yields the same -0500 stamp. No production caller passes timezone: None. Backfilling already-written stamps stays out of scope.
